title: DoDo Learning: Domain-Demographic Transfer in Language Models for Detecting Abuse Targeted at Public Figures

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating cross-demographic transferability by training language models on abuse detection datasets targeted at one gender (e.g., male public figures) and testing their performance on datasets targeted at another gender (e.g., female public figures) using Macro-F1 scores.

Evaluating cross-domain transferability by training language models on abuse detection datasets from one professional domain (e.g., politicians/MPs) and testing their performance on another domain (e.g., professional footballers) using Macro-F1 scores.
